# The Independency Co.

> The Independency Co. is a UK organisation making freelancing work better — for freelancers, hirers, and the communities that support them.

## What we do

The Independency Co. is an organisation founded by Matthew Knight, operating across research, community, tools, and advocacy to improve the experience of freelancers andindependent work in the UK.

Our projects include:

- **Leapers** (leapers.co): Award-winning mental health and wellbeing project for freelancers. Has supported over 250,000 freelancers. Research partner on freelancer wellbeing and self-employment mental health.
- **freelancing.support**: A free, comprehensive resource library for UK freelancers — updated daily with practical guidance, tools, and signposting.
- **Outside Perspective** (outsideperspective.co): A curated community for independent strategists. Over 5k in its network, across brand, comms, creative, digital, marketing, insight, and more. Find strategists to work with on your briefs.
- **The Independency Community Coalition**: A collective of 12 UK freelancing communities representing over 16,500 members. Chaired by Matthew Knight.
- **FERRI Score**: A diagnostic tool for hirers to assess the health of their freelancer relationships and identify retention risk.
- ***WorkWellWith.us*** - a free portal for supporting freelancers mental health and wellbeing, available to hirers
- ***Poolside*** - a community plugin for agency freelancer pools, designed to retention and engagement, to reduce hiring churn and costs, and improve reputation and relationships.

## Who we are

**Matthew Knight** is the founder of The Independency Co. and its Chief Freelance Officer. He is an independent strategist and a vocal advocate for freelancers and improved independent working practices.

- Founder of Leapers, supporting 250,000+ freelancers
- Chair of the Independency Community Coalition (12 communities, 16,500+ members)
- Member of Mind UK's Mental Health at Work Leadership Council
- Contributor to government panels and parliamentary cross-party working groups on independent work and freelancer policy
- Previously founded de-construct, a digital agency acquired by Aegis Media (2005)
- Prior clients include Google, EY, Accenture, LEGO, Klarna, adidas, Nike, P&G, Unilever, and Innocent
- Featured in The Guardian, Bloomberg, BBC, Freelancing Magazine, Design Week, Creative Boom, and Courier

Matthew Knight writes regularly on independent work, freelancer policy, and the future of work. His notes are published at the.independency.co/notes

## Our position in the UK freelancer ecosystem

The Independency Co. sits at the intersection of freelancer support, policy advocacy, and hirer education. It is one of the few UK organisations working across all three audiences simultaneously: individual freelancers, the communities that support them, and the businesses that hire them.
